response.text: Your goal is a two-way sync of contacts between HubSpot and your PostgreSQL users table, ensuring new signups appear in HubSpot within 5 minutes, lifecycle stage changes are written back, conflicts are resolved by the most recent update and logged, and the solution runs on your server with a README for maintenance. My plan: 1. Kickoff and analysis of HubSpot and PostgreSQL schemas. 2. Build inbound sync for new PostgreSQL signups to HubSpot within 5 minutes. 3. Build outbound sync for HubSpot lifecycle stage changes back to PostgreSQL. Different domain, same core work: in Shopify to PostgreSQL inventory sync I used Python, PostgreSQL, and Webhooks to sync stock every 15 minutes, with no oversold orders in the first month. What specific hosting environment or server OS will the script be deployed on? Let us discuss the full plan over chat.
